systems.name: 5.1 Throwable/Transfer System
systems.notes: Core co-op interaction. Players can toss resources or give directly. Host-authoritative physics with client-side prediction for feel. Throw arc should be clear and snappy.

tasks.text: Aiming arc + toss item entity (client prediction?)
tasks.notes: Client predicts trajectory; host validates and corrects.

tasks.text: Host spawns physics object, collides player → item transfer
tasks.notes: Simple projectile; on collision, move item to target inventory.
Instant give within short range; no projectile.

systems.name: 5.2 Revive & Drag
systems.notes: Downed state when suit fails completely or hazard damage is fatal. Teammates can revive (or Grub if upgraded). Dragging allows moving a downed player to safety. If player is not revived in time use normal respawn behavior.

tasks.text: Downed state (ragdoll when goblin/locked suit when mech), hold interact to repair
tasks.notes: Player can still look around; progress bar for revive.
Tie to Grub's ability tree from 4.3.

tasks.text: Drag mechanic: slow movement while pulling teammate
tasks.notes: One player can drag another; movement speed reduced.

systems.name: 5.3 Shared Camp Inventory
systems.notes: Already partially handled by Phase 1 chest sync. Ensure all camp chests are accessible and synced for all players. No additional complex logic needed.

tasks.text: All camp chests accessible to all players, synced (phase 1 handles)

systems.name: 5.4 Partner-Specific Abilities (Optional)
systems.notes: Keep design modular for future goblin character variants. Not a priority for now; placeholder for future expansion.
